svg.text: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) document assistant running on Amazon EKS
download as PDF / DOCX / XML / more
scaling 1 to 3 pods, self-healing after pod restart
API keys: Kubernetes Secret (never in GitHub)
tried first, blocked on this account
if no LLM is reachable: closest
1 browser uploads PDF > 2 backend saves it in S3 > 3 Textract extracts text per page > 4 chunks + vectors saved to the S3 index
1 retrieve top chunks > 2 send only those chunks to the LLM (Bedrock first, Gemini now) > 3 answer + citations (document, page, passage)
Dashed = unavailable or fallback path. Out-of-scope questions return no chunks, so the app answers: Information not available in the uploaded documents.
